title: Keep selector results stable for unrelated updates
contract: Implement createLoanSelector(), returning a one-entry memoized select(state) function. state has items and filters {status,search}; unrelated ui fields may change. Filter status unless ALL, and match applicantName case-insensitively using trimmed search. Reuse the exact previous result array when the items reference, status value and normalized search are unchanged, even if state/filters objects are fresh. Recompute when those inputs change. Keep cache private to each selector instance. Inputs are frozen.
hints: Filtering into a new array on every call changes the reference even when contents match.
Cache only by actual inputs: items reference and primitive filters, not the entire state or filters object.

tests.name: Opening a drawer preserves the selector result reference
tests.explanation: useSelector observes result identity, so a fresh but identical array causes a render.

tests.name: A changed status recomputes the result
tests.explanation: Memoization must not hide real filter changes.

tests.name: Equivalent search and fresh filter objects reuse the cache
tests.explanation: Normalize the search before comparing cache keys.

tests.name: A replacement items reference invalidates the cache
tests.explanation: Store changes must be reflected in the derived list.

tests.name: Cache empty results just like populated arrays
tests.explanation: A missing match is still a valid memoized result.

businessContext: Typing into the search input causes all 50 table rows, all 5 metric cards, and the drawer component to re-render on every single character, causing typing latency on low-power devices.
productionSymptom: React DevTools Profiler shows 60+ component re-renders per keystroke with render durations exceeding 120ms, dropping frame rates below 20fps.
